Folded in: its two written name-history accounts (meaning, after Behind the Name; Omar Ahmed Youssouf, Présidence de Djibouti 2017), the spelling Youssouf in Chad, Djibouti and the Comoros (Forebears), the bearer Omar Ahmed Youssouf, its origin claims and its Behind the Name, Présidence and Forebears sources. Not carried: the spelling Yousouf and the Somali and Comorian links, which rested on the candidate queue alone.

Not carried: the Arabs of Africa link, which rested on the candidate queue alone.
